## Problem

Describe the concrete problem and link the requirement, issue, or decision.

## Resulting behavior

Explain what this change does and the behavior a user or caller will observe.
Identify any contract, schema, compatibility, or data-handling changes.

## Verification

Record the exact commands and observed results. Include relevant environment
details, concrete failure cases, and material skips. For documentation-only
changes, describe the review performed instead of inventing a test requirement.

## Risks and limits

State remaining limitations and the recovery or rollback approach when relevant.
For performance or AI changes, link the applicable measurement or evaluation
evidence. Distinguish proposed behavior from verified implementation.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change follows the Golden Coding Standard and uses US English.
- [ ] Original content, provenance, and uncertainty remain accurately represented.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, unrelated private data, or unauthorized assets.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and meaningful behavioral tests are current.
- [ ] Capability and performance claims match the evidence reported above.
